entry.title: Unboxing the Cryptic Killer
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺99,99 → ₺79,99 [₺49,99 ~ ₺99,99]）

All Price Information

Price：₺79,99

Application Description

SOLVE A CRYPTIC BOX Unboxing the Cryptic Killer is the first standalone chapter to the cooperative point-and-click puzzle game series 'Cryptic Killer'. Join forces with a friend and play as detective partners Ally and Old Dog in our debut two-player escape room adventure. IMPORTANT: "Unboxing the Cryptic Killer" is a 2-player cooperative puzzle game, that requires each player to have their own copy on either mobile, tablet, PC or Mac. Internet connection and voice communication are essential. Need a Player Two? Join our Discord community! Two seasoned detectives, Ally and Old Dog, are entangled in a chilling unsolved case. Lured on a perilous trail, they fall into the clutches of the enigmatic Cryptic Killer they've been relentlessly pursuing. The stakes are sky-high as two innocent lives hang in the balance. In order to save them, Ally and Old Dog must unravel a box of intricate puzzles masterfully designed by the nefarious killer. Test your mettle and join this high-stakes race against time, where every puzzle solved is a step closer to unmasking the Cryptic Killer. THE ONLY WAY TO ESCAPE IS TO WORK TOGETHER Unboxing the Cryptic Killer is a puzzle for exactly two players. The name of the game is collaboration. Each player takes on one of the two roles and works their way through a series of challenging puzzles. You'll each see one half of the same puzzle and must work together to crack the codes and escape the Cryptic Killer's clutches. FEATURES LIST ▶Two Player Co-Op In Unboxing the Cryptic Killer, the detectives are separated. You’ll see different items and clues than your partner, and will be tested on your communication! ▶Challenging Collaborative Puzzles Two brains are better than one when it comes to cracking the Cryptic Killer's codes. ▶Unravel a Thrilling Story Track the Cryptic Killer's movements as Detectives Old Dog and Ally in this ongoing murder mystery saga. ▶Explore Illustrated Worlds Unboxing the Cryptic Killer features hand-illustrated environments that are inspired by noir novels. ▶Draw on… Everything! You cannot solve a case without taking notes. At any time in the game, you can whip out a notebook and pen to make notes and scribble on your environment.

Application Description

Build the dungeon. Set the traps. Wait for the heroes. Skel & Defense is a dungeon defense roguelike where you play the villain. Expand your dungeon room by room, fill it with deadly traps, transform into Skel, and stop wave after wave of heroes coming for your treasure. Combine the strategy of tower defense with the replayability of a roguelike, and build a dungeon no adventuring party can survive. ◆ Become the Dungeon Master, Not the Hero Every dungeon has a monster waiting in the darkness. This time, that monster is you. At night, expand your dungeon and prepare your traps. During the day, defend the gates against waves of invading heroes. Build, defend, improve, and repeat. Turn a humble underground tomb into an unstoppable fortress. ◆ 26 Trap Rooms, Countless Combinations Build and combine 26 unique trap rooms, including fireballs, lava zones, freezing mist, icicles, saw blades, poison arrows, electromagnetic fields, and more. Combine rooms of the same element to unlock powerful synergies. Freeze enemies before burning them alive. Trap them in narrow corridors and finish them with poison. Your dungeon layout determines how long the heroes survive. ◆ Transform into Skel and Fight Traps are not your only weapon. Transform into different Skels and fight the invaders yourself. Become a Mage Skel and launch fireballs from the rear, a Rogue Skel throwing shurikens, or a Shield Skel holding the front line. When your traps are not enough, finish the job yourself. ◆ 7 Stages, Endless Mode, Global Rankings Conquer 7 stages with different rewards, then enter Endless Mode and face increasingly powerful waves. How long can your dungeon survive? Register a nickname in the options menu to join the global rankings and compete with players around the world. ◆ Over 30 Perks, A Different Run Every Time Choose from more than 30 perks during each stage. Take powerful upgrades to strengthen your build, or accept dangerous penalties in exchange for bonus score. Focus entirely on traps, strengthen your Skel, or combine both approaches. Every run is different, and every decision matters. ◆ Grow Stronger with Every Run Defeat waves to earn Trait Points and unlock permanent upgrades that make future runs stronger. Explore the Collection to uncover hidden synergies, new rooms, and powerful relics. There is always one more strategy to discover. ◆ Full Controller Support Prefer playing with a controller? Build rooms, choose perks, use the shop, warp through the dungeon, browse the Collection, and control every major screen with a gamepad. On-screen button prompts are supported, and you can freely switch between controller and touch controls. ◆ A Premium Dungeon Defense Built for Replayability Short runs. Deep strategy. And that feeling of wanting to survive just one more wave. • Dungeon defense combined with roguelike progression • 26 trap rooms with elemental synergies • Multiple Skel forms for direct combat • 7 stages plus an increasingly difficult Endless Mode • Global ranking competition • More than 30 perks that change every run • Permanent upgrades, relics, and hidden synergies • Full gamepad support • Cloud save support • Playable in 13 languages If you enjoy tower defense games, roguelikes and roguelites, dungeon management, base defense, strategy games, or survivor-style action, Skel & Defense was built for you. The heroes are already coming. Build your dungeon, prepare your traps, and show them who the real master of the dungeon is.

entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺249,99 → ₺199,99 [₺99,99 ~ ₺249,99]）

All Price Information

Price：₺199,99

Application Description

A small detail can hide a whole world. Open up the view and discover the unexpected story waiting around it. Duopaper is a collection of wide digital pictures with a playful sense of reveal. A folded preview brings one part into focus; the expanded preview shows the whole composition. Both belong to the same image, giving you a different way to choose a background for a foldable or wider display. Find a look that suits your mood. Explore Minimal, Illustration, Comics, 3D, Graphic, and Painterly styles, from gentle colours to bold little scenes. Try the clock overlay, move between views, and adjust the preview focus to discover the details you enjoy most. Browse offline, keep favourites on your device, and save a complete HD image to your photo library. Share a favourite scene whenever you want to pass on the surprise. The entire experience is free, with no ads, in-app purchases, or account required. After saving, follow the guide to set the picture manually; the in-app views are a preview, and system cropping or transitions may differ.
